What the system does

Everything a plant needs — in 4 areas.

Laboratory & Quality
  • Laboratory (LIMS) — assays and Certificate of Analysis in 1 click
  • Quality control — reagents, curves, calibration, specifications
  • NC / CAPA — deviation becomes 8D corrective action with escalation

Documents & People
  • Documents (DMS) — current version, approval and history

Compliance (over everything)

  • Risk Management (ICH Q9) — risk matrix, mitigation and materialization into NC
  • Cryptographic trail — every action signed and verifiable

11 modules + 2 layers (BI & platform) — a single system, all linked.

Why it impresses

It's not a CRUD. It's heavy engineering.

Each of these takes months of specialized work. All already built and working:

Inventory that talks to the lab

Receiving in the WMS already computes the sample that goes to the lab. Inventory and LIMS connected — nothing is retyped.

Living, linked documentation

An approved document feeds training; the assay uses the approved specification; the workflow ties it together. The system shows what changed, character by character.

Smart blocking

Expired reagent or uncalibrated equipment? The system prevents use. Reagent and curve consumption auto-debited by method.

Automatic competency matrix

Fills itself from completed training. The auditor asks who was trained — you open the screen and show.

NC → CAPA with escalation

The nonconformity escalates to 8D CAPA automatically by severity and recurrence. OOS opens itself from the lab.

Documents that generate themselves

Certificate of Analysis in under 60s, Batch Record (EBR), SDS and reports — generated from approved specifications.

Data integrity

Cryptographic proof that no one altered your data.

  • Each record chained with SHA-256 — change one character, the chain breaks and the system detects it
  • Ed25519 digital signature on approvals, documents and forms
  • Integrity verification at any time
  • Isolated multi-tenant (one PostgreSQL schema per client)

Security & access

Hardened to the standard the auditor demands.

bcrypt passwords

Never plaintext. Constant-time login — you can't discover which emails exist.

Brute force blocked

Rate limiting in 2 layers (IP + account) with progressive lockout, before bcrypt.

Secure sessions

HttpOnly + Secure + SameSite cookie with a 256-bit token. Server-side session, revocable, 2h expiry.

2FA (TOTP)

Two-step authentication with the secret encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM).

Per-company isolation

Each client in an isolated PostgreSQL schema + RBAC by department.

Integrity & files

SHA-256 + Ed25519 trail and private uploads (only via authenticated, tenant-scoped API).
